input.prompt: The survey drone flies steadily toward the camera with its nose and camera gimbal pointing forward in its direction of travel, while the camera pulls back at the same speed to keep it framed. Propellers spin as blurred discs, navigation lights glow, the tower cranes and concrete cores drift past behind it in the dawn haze. Its heading never changes: it always faces the way it is flying. Smooth tracking shot. Photorealistic, natural physics, steady professional camera, one continuous shot with no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.

The survey drone keeps flying forward toward the camera over the misty construction site, heading constant, nose and gimbal pointing the way it travels; the camera retreats and slowly descends ahead of it so the site opens up below. Propellers spin as blurred discs, navigation lights glow, cranes and concrete cores pass beneath. Smooth tracking shot. Photorealistic, natural physics, steady professional camera, one continuous shot with no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.

The survey drone banks gently to the right and flies away from the camera, passing behind the tall concrete tower on the right and disappearing behind the building. The camera holds steady on the construction site as the drone leaves the frame; mist drifts, cranes stand still, dawn light on the structures. Photorealistic, natural physics, steady professional camera, one continuous shot with no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.

An empty industrial plant room. After a moment a white humanoid robot steps out from behind the large pipes in the middle distance and walks down the central aisle toward the camera with a steady, confident gait. The camera holds almost still. The room, pipes, machines, floor and window light stay exactly the same throughout; nothing in the environment changes. Photorealistic, natural physics, steady professional camera, one continuous shot with no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.

The white humanoid robot walks down the central aisle of the plant room toward the camera with a natural, steady gait while the camera slowly dollies backward to keep it in frame. The plant room, pipes, machines, floor and lighting remain exactly the same throughout. In the final second the robot walks right up to and past the camera so its white torso fills the whole frame. Photorealistic, natural physics, steady professional camera, one continuous shot with no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.
